evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: A compact matched contrast states the distinction directly, with flat declarative delivery and no audience-oriented flourish.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: The semicolon-bound contrast presents an evaluative distinction as a concise, controlled maxim.
The hyphenated abstract terminology is a technical labeling move rather than an accessible conversational rendering.
